In the remaining C=8 fiber, the exact equations sum(x_j)=4 and sum(j*x_j)=8 have eight explicitly listed solutions. Exactly choose(4,2)=6 are index-four words, and the two remaining aabbbbaa and bbaaaabb have exactly two arches. This exhausts all lengths<=8 and is corroborated by independent direct subsequence tests on 511 words and bounded-partition recurrence; no finite observation is extrapolated.

originality.rationale: The contribution is neither binary Parikh-matrix parameterization nor existential/universal endpoint arithmetic: it is the first possible strict gap and unique noninterval class through length eight, including its eight representatives. The 2026 source full text studies index endpoints and fixed-pattern probabilities, not the exact attainable intermediate-index set. The full inspected earlier partition analysis gives a bijection but not the index-gap phenomenon. The published overall binary index distribution is an unconditional marginal, incapable by itself of resolving the conditional C=8 class. Seven targeted published-finding corpus queries, three web queries and comparison to earlier relevant published claims found no covering statement; residual unindexed literature risk remains and absence of search hits is not used as a uniqueness proof.
residual_risks: Unindexed or differently named earlier research may contain the same small counterexample or a stronger joint spectrum theorem.
A general formula for the joint four-variable distribution could logically subsume this classification if one exists; no such covering source was found in checked literature.
Only initial-length spectra, not arbitrary-length gaps, are claimed.

value.rationale: The motivating work studies the extremal existential and universal indices for each fixed (A,B,C) Parikh-matrix class. Knowing endpoints 2 and 4 leaves the natural interval-filling property unresolved. This result supplies its first and unique possible obstruction at the forced minimum length 8, a complete exact fiber and a robust boundary: the five candidate C values are narrowed to one. It is a motivated structural counterexample to a natural question about constrained subsequence universality, not an arbitrary slice or recasting of known endpoint arithmetic.
